notes: SFCC/Demandware site. Discovered via robots.txt sitemaps (sitemap_1.xml grepped for christmas/holiday/halloween/thanksgiving/valentine/easter/festive/new-year slugs), the /holiday PLP's own refinement pages, and homepage main-nav (dropdown item re-decor-hd-type-holiday 301-redirects to /holiday, confirming it as the genuine nav category). No Valentine's Day, Easter, New Year, or Diwali/Indian-festival categories exist on this site (0 matching sitemap URLs after checking English terms). Only Christmas/Holiday, Halloween, and Thanksgiving are genuine seasonal categories. /holiday (title 'Holiday Collection', 481 Results) is the site's own top umbrella node for Christmas-season bedding/decor/apparel and is recorded as a grouping row (sub_category set equal to category per contract). Below it the site exposes three mid-level aggregator pages (data-cgid nav-holiday-type-decor 'Holiday Decor' 114 Results, nav-holiday-type-bedding 'Holiday Sheets and Bedding' 70 Results, nav-holiday-type-pajamas 'Holiday Pajamas & Apparel' 16 Results) whose own products are strict subsets of the specific leaf categories captured below (each leaf verified via its own man-holiday-type-* / man-holiday-themes-* cgid) - per the shared core's parent/subset rule these three aggregator pages are omitted entirely (never double-count) and only their leaf children are recorded flat under Christmas. 'Holiday Matching Family Pajamas' (16 Results) has an identical first-page product-tile set to the (omitted) 'Holiday Pajamas & Apparel' aggregator and is a superset of 'Holiday Pajamas for Kids & Babies' (4) and 'Holiday Pet Pajamas' (2), which are also included as their own genuine audience-specific PLPs; overlap noted here rather than dropping any, since Family/Kids/Pet are sibling-level named categories, not a strict parent-of-parent chain. Dropped as 0-current-results genuine categories (site's own 'no results' state, not proof of non-existence but not extractable as inventory today): Holiday Comforters, Reusable Holiday Gift Bags, Holiday Tree Print Bedding PJs & Decor (Holiday Trees theme), Berry Theme Holiday Bedding & Decor, Bird Print Holiday Bedding Pajamas & Decor. Excluded as non-genuine-seasonal or marketing: 'Christmas Shop' (cgid man-holiday-christmas-preview, no result count/refinement/sort controls - a curated preview/landing page, not a real PLP), 'Fall Floral Bedding' (fall-florals, 114 Results - a floral print theme tied to the Fall season generally, not a holiday/festival event), 'Cold Weather Bedding, Pajamas, and Apparel' (fall-winter-bedding-apparel - a climate/season merchandising category, not an event), 'Winter Forest Bedding, Bath & Decor' (a print theme, currently 0 results, and not itself an event-based category), holiday-guides / how-to-host-*.html / *-guide.html / *-tips.html pages (blog/editorial), holiday-new-arrivals and holiday-sale-bedding-apparel-and-decor and bestsellers-holiday-bedding-apparel-decor and featured-holiday-bedding-apparel-and-decor (New Arrivals/Sale/Bestsellers/Featured nav exclusions). Halloween and Thanksgiving are each a single flat site category (man-holiday-themes-halloween / man-holiday-themes-thanksgiving) with no further sub-pages found in the sitemap beyond a blog/guide page (excluded). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; all pages fetched via direct HTTP.
